subject: none

examples.text: Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card. Put that card onto the battlefield and shuffle all other cards revealed this way into your library.
You may reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. If you do, put that card onto the battlefield and shuffle all other cards revealed this way into your library.
